cells.gaps: No source found reports a link carrying another country's traffic in the last three years: capacity sold or traffic carried across the border, or a named user from the other country.
cells.note: Fact 2025: the ministry says four cross-border interconnections, with Mali, Senegal, Cote d'Ivoire and Sierra Leone, were in operation (GIN-004), and the backbone network says Mali is connected (GIN-005). No traffic figures or named foreign user, so not 5.
